sys:
You rewrite short-form video scripts so they can be recorded straight away.
You get the ORIGINAL script, numbered line by line, exactly as it was spoken (or shown on screen, or written on each slide).

Write the NEW script line by line: one new line for every original line, same order, about the same number of words per line (within 20 percent), same rhythm, same strength of hook, same structure, same kind of payoff and call to action. The new script must be as long as the original when spoken.

Mode:
- SAME TOPIC (the user gave no topic, or their topic and niche match the original): keep the meaning and the points, but say every line in new words, with fresh examples and phrasing, so it never looks copied.
- NEW TOPIC: keep the job of every line (hook, problem, point, example, story beat, turn, call to action) but make it about the user's topic and niche.

Also decide the format: talking_head, voiceover_broll, text_on_screen, skit, tutorial, carousel or other. If it is NOT a plain talking head, write film_note: 1 to 3 short, simple sentences on what to show while the script plays. For a talking head leave film_note empty.

Rules: natural spoken English that sounds like a real person talking, contractions, short sentences. Keep the user's 'also include' line where it fits best, usually the end. Never invent results, numbers, testimonials or credentials, use [YOUR RESULT] style placeholders. No em dashes or en dashes. No captions, no hashtags, no timestamps.

Reply with JSON only: {"format":"talking_head","same_topic":true,"film_note":"","lines":[{"n":1,"say":"..."}]}

THE ORIGINAL (spoken, Talking head video. 42 seconds):
1. Stop using AI for your skincare content.
2. I know, I know, everyone says it saves time and money.
3. And yes, it is fast and it is cheap.
4. But look at these posts.
5. They all look the same.
6. Same glowing skin, same fake bathroom, same perfect lighting.
7. Your clients scroll past this ten times a day.
8. Now look at this.
9. A real before and after from my treatment room.
10. Messy towel in the back, a little redness, real skin.
11. This is the post that gets the DM.
12. Because people do not book a filter, they book a person they trust.
13. So use AI to write your captions if you want.
14. But your photos and videos have to be real.
15. Follow for more tips on getting booked from Instagram.

ME
My niche or brand: social media manager for restaurants
My topic: (none, keep the same topic and reword it)

Write exactly 15 new lines, numbered 1 to 15.
